meta.about: NPCs that lie dormant until a player comes near (trigger "approach") or attacks them ("attacked"), then rise as their awake form, fight, and sink back after resting. Pairs and animations are from the cache: crabs share one skeleton (1316 rises, 74 client cycles, so 3 ticks; 1314 sinks); wyrms rise with wyrm_transition_up (8268, 90 cycles: 3 ticks) and sink with wyrm_transition_down (8269, 60 cycles: 2 ticks), wyrmlings sharing the wyrm's animations. Behaviour from the OSRS Wiki (Sand Crab, Rock Crab, Tolerance, Wyrm). restTicks isn't documented anywhere and is an estimate; so is it for wyrms (no capture yet). Zygomites (Zanaris, placeholders 536/1023 showing Fungi 533/538 with Pick) are from a rev 243 capture: human_fungicide_pick_zygomite (3335) and sound pick (2581) the tick after arrival; the next tick the cap transforms (537/1024) with zygomite_leap_out_npc (12340, 56 cycles: 2 ticks) and sound zygo_grow (1963), its options disabled until it has risen; the in-combat refusal is captured. How a zygomite turns back into Fungi isn't captured: it rests like the others and turns back with no animation (ours).
